Not PROTECTED (grind_config PROTECT covers only irq1_handler, not_vsync_2ed0, wait_for_vsync_2242; PROTECT_BYTES only &0004-&001E), not generated, not raster-timed, no data/table/RAM moved. buf_ss/crtc/vl/vr (render_bss, &BC42..) are read only by buffer_to_view (sole caller render.6502:515, X=2) and buf_vl_lo/hi+2 (395-396); no tool reads them; so view_to_buffer(back) at :517 stores nothing anyone reads (its X kept, A/flags overwritten by LDA buf_lives,X). The view bytes &00/&01/&B0-&B3/&BA/&BB are written in step-2 code only by buffer_to_view, history_to_view (only in the pending_n<>0 loop), prebuild (before render's view_to_buffer(2), restored in keep_zp) and restore_game_zp (render end); in game.6502 only scroll_screen_left/right and reset_screen_scroll (logic, never during render, not the IRQ); no sky/kindcache/compiled/shield/timer code writes them, no indexed zp write reaches them. So with pending_n=0 the live view already equals buf_*[2] and the restore is a no-op; restore_game_zp's comment (render_zp.6502:129) stays true. Paging: runs with ROMSEL &04 and ACCCON X possibly set; buf_* in bank 4 workspace and zp are unaffected either way, the remaining code reads the same RAM. Room: net 0 bytes (JSR 3 removed, SKIP 3 added after the BRA, never executed); .lives_drawn stays &9334. Branches: BEQ at &92EE -> new .scrolled &9321 (offset &31, still crosses &92->&93, +1 as before); BNE at &9314 -> &931C, same page as before. No other reference to 'scrolled' in src or tools. Same on every path (front end does not run render; helicopter, game over, completion, gameplay and SKY_HELI=0 builds run the same unconditional lines). Recount: view_to_buffer JSR+8x(LDA zp 3 + STA abs,X 5)+RTS = 76 saved every pass; plus LDX #2 + buffer_to_view (6+8x7+6=68)+2 = 70.. i.e. 72 more when nothing scrolled (148 then, 76 on scroll passes), consistent with the measured average 118 a pass.
